site.text: a cairn of black stones, half-sunk
a sinkhole rimmed with pale reeds
a toppled waystone, its runes scoured
a scorched hollow where nothing grows
a dry wash littered with sun-bleached bone
a shepherd's shelter, its roof long gone
a lonely marker leaning off the path

detail.text: The air is wrong here — too still, too watchful.
Old offerings rot in a niche, some barely cold.
Frost rimes every surface though the season forbids it.
The mud holds footprints that lead only inward.
A faint sigil-hum rises as you step closer.
Ash sifts down from a sky with no cloud.

complication.text: Something watches from just past the light.
A cold thread of dread says not everything here is dead.
Fresh tracks say you are not the first here today.
A resonance that matches no known ley-line pulls at your teeth.
